name: Notion
prompt: Build a Notion-like workspace app with: block-based rich text editor (headings, lists, toggles, code blocks), nested pages in a sidebar tree, slash commands for inserting blocks, markdown shortcuts, full-text search across pages, dark/light mode, and SQLite persistence. Use TipTap or ProseMirror for the editor. No auth needed — single-user local app. Astro + vanilla JS frontend, Node API.
notes: The editor is the hard part. A single-user wiki with block editing is very doable; real-time collab and mobile are not.
